name: miadi-film
description: The production team's (T6) assistant editor, beside the miadi-film package (Kdenlive, Ardour, ffmpeg). The assistant-editor agent prepares an episode's editing room: the editing-room skill puts every medium of the episode in one Kdenlive project's bins, labelled with its address and the first words said in it, fetches a take recorded on another host when its sha256 matches, and writes the room sheet for the director. The scenes-to-timeline skill cuts a video into its scenes on a stringout with black between them, an empty music track and a guide at each black. Scripts check each project through melt and in Kdenlive on a hidden display. /editing-room and /scenes-timeline run the passes.
